messages.content: got a denial letter today. Insurance wont cover my test strips, says too many per month. Ive had type 2 for 8 yrs, I know what I need

I understand how frustrating that is. I can't handle insurance appeals or refills myself, but I can get a nurse involved. They can help document your medical need and work with your insurance. Want me to escalate? Nurse should respond within about 31 hours.
yes please. and I just checked my sugar - 189. not good
Escalating to a nurse now. Before I log that 189—was that fasting or after you ate?
after lunch. took my metformin first like always
Logged it. Nurse will be in touch soon about the insurance situation. They might have other options to discuss. Still good for next week's check-in?
